# Bloomscroll

> Bloomscroll checks health and appearance claims against published biomedical
> research and returns a graded verdict with real, retrievable citations.

Site: https://getbloomscroll.com
Contact: getbloomscroll@gmail.com

## What it is

Bloomscroll is a web tool and Chrome extension that fact-checks health and
appearance claims — the kind that circulate in short-form social video and
wellness content — against peer-reviewed biomedical literature.

A user pastes a claim, a link, or an article, or shares a post to Bloomscroll
from their phone or browser. Bloomscroll extracts the parts of that text that
are actually testable, searches Europe PMC (an open index of over 45 million
peer-reviewed biomedical papers), and returns a verdict for each claim with
citations the user can open.

## How the verdict works

Every claim is graded on a five-tier scale rather than being marked true or
false:

- Supported — multiple decent studies point the same way
- Mixed evidence — real studies exist and they disagree
- Weak evidence — something exists, but it is thin
- No evidence found — nothing in the retrieved literature addresses it
- Not a testable claim — the statement is not empirical

The scale exists because most claims of this kind are neither true nor false;
they are under-researched, contested, or not empirical at all, and a binary
verdict misrepresents that.

## Citation integrity

Bloomscroll only cites papers it actually retrieved from the literature search.
Every citation is validated against that retrieved set before it renders, so a
fabricated or hallucinated source cannot appear in a result. This is the
specific difference from asking a general-purpose chatbot, which will invent
plausible-looking references when it does not know an answer.

## What it does not do

Bloomscroll explains what published research says about a claim and how strong
that research is. It does not diagnose, treat, or give medical advice, and it
is not a substitute for a clinician.

## Access

- Web: https://getbloomscroll.com
- Chrome extension: click the toolbar icon to check the current page, or
  right-click selected text
- iPhone and Android: added to the system share sheet, so any post can be sent
  to Bloomscroll directly
- Install guides: https://getbloomscroll.com/access

## Pricing

A free tier covers a small number of checks per month with no payment details
required. Paid tiers raise or remove that cap. Built-in example claims do not
count against any allowance.
